{{Main|Fareham Borough Council elections}}

The '''2026 Fareham Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 16 of 32 members of [[Fareham Borough Council]] in [[Hampshire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Elections and Voting|url=https://www.fareham.gov.uk/about_the_council/elections_and_voting/intro.aspx|website=www.fareham.gov.uk|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-gb}}</ref>

Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this will be the final election to Fareham Borough Council before it is abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]]. Elections to the successor authority are due to take place in 2027.

==Summary==

===Background===
In [[2024 Fareham Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Fareham Borough Council local elections results: full list|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/news/24296182.full-list-fareham-borough-council-local-election-results/|website=Daily Echo|date=2024-05-03|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Fareham result - Local Elections 2024|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000087|work=BBC News|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}}</ref>

*December 2024: Lisa Whittle (Liberal Democrats) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Down Brierley Hill and up Dale |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2024/12/down-brierley-hill-and-up-dale/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*February 2025: Paul Whittle (Liberal Democrats) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=SNP move in for the Killie |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/02/snp-move-in-for-the-killie/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*May 2025: Lisa Whittle (Independent) and Paul Whittle (Independent) join Conservatives<ref>{{cite news |last1=Needs |first1=Noni |title=Councillors switching parties |url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/news/25171286.fareham-lib-dem-duos-switch-conservatives-sparks-anger/ |access-date=7 February 2026 |work=Daily Echo |date=20 May 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
